corrections.reason: In the nominative Ge'ez phrase 'ናሁ ብዙኅ ሰብእ ይደዓቅ ወይጣወቅ', the adjective modifies nominative 'ሰብእ' and is printed in the 6th order (ሳድስ) as 'ብዙኅ'.
Completes 'እን↵ጂ' from the end of Column 2 Line 40; the 3rd order (ሣልስ) 'ጂ' is visible at the start of the line.
The printed glyph in 'መምህራን' is 'ህ' (consistent with line 15 below), not 'ሕ'.
Canonical Ge'ez Matthew 9:24 plural imperative 'ተግኅሡ' (translated in the next line as plural 'ተመለሱ'); the 2nd order (ካዕብ) stroke on 'ሡ' is visible.
The verb at the end of the page continues mid-word onto the next page ('ያስነሣል↵ናል ብሎ ይዞ መጣ').
